en.title: Adding Participants Manually
en.excerpt: How tournament organizers can manually enroll walk-in archers, offline registrants, or invited international delegates.
en.content:
Use Cases for Manual Entry

Manual participant enrollment is essential for handling on-site walk-in registrations at the venue secretariat, cash payments, or enrolling sponsored international delegates without requiring them to complete online checkout.

Step-by-Step Manual Registration

  1. Go to Tournament Dashboard > Participants.
  2. Click + Add Manual Participant in the top header.
  3. Enter the athlete information: Full Name, Gender, Date of Birth, Email (optional), and Club Affiliation.
  4. Assign the athlete to the target Competition Division.

Payment Status Overrides

Select the Mark as Paid (Cash / Offline) toggle to verify the athlete immediately and assign them an active spot in target butt allocation without generating an online invoice.

Batch Participant Import

For large school contingents, organizers can use the Excel template import feature to upload hundreds of athletes across multiple divisions in a single file upload.
